notes.title: Demo v0.1.9.2226 Patch Notes (New view modes for Layered Stats UI)
notes.content:
Features
Added \[Spirit View Mode]: Easily assess the Spirit level of all residences through color-coding.

Layered Statistics UI now supports multiple view modes:

\[Resource Stats]: Views material quantities per floor.

\[Towertizen Stats]: Displays population/jobs/available workers/homeless count per floor.

\[Food Supply]: Monitor food reserves and manually set consumables per floor (custom menus).

\[Tower Buffs]: Views buff effects on each tower section.

Homeless Towertizens can now work and will retain their job status when moving into housing.


Changes
Default construction priority changed to Medium.

Added camera rotation with Q/E keys.

Shift+Click now enables copy-placement of buildings under construction.


Bugfixes
Fixed abnormal material returns when demolishing Brick Houses.

Fixed Brick Houses not downgrading when residents' basic needs fell below the threshold.

Corrected stability miscalculations for floating structures causing purple tint in Stability Mode.


UI
Added an "Open Save Folder" button to save/load screen.

Removed framerate options from resolution settings (resolution-only now).

Standardized red warning text colors across all UI.

Optimized item ordering in key remapping panel.

notes.title: Demo Update Log v0.1.8.2102
notes.content:

Demolishing or downgrading residential buildings now creates homeless Towertizens (visible in the bottom status bar). They will linger on the tower for a while and will move into any vacant housing immediately.

Changes:

New Towertizen arrival rate now scales with the amount of Lifeneeds in storage. However, even with insufficient resources, a few explorers from the Down City may still come to investigate.

Default job priority for new Lifeneeds production jobs at new Atmospheric Zone is now set to highest.

Slightly reduced probability of Towertizens being blown away by disasters.

Bugfixes:

Fixed a bug where all item names in the food and drink statistics panel were incorrectly displayed as "Sea Buckthorn".

UI：

Redesigned bottom resource status bar. Now clearly displays demand/reserve status per Atmospheric Zone.

Residential buildings now show demand bubbles and UI warnings when vacancies occur due to missing Lifeneeds.

New Lifeneeds prompts appear in the resource bar upon entering new Atmospheric Zone.

notes.title: Demo Update on Jun 6 & Save Data Notice
notes.content:
Hi everyone!



We are rolling out a major update for the demo of our game, STARIO: the Heaven Tower, on June 6!



In this new version, the lockable tower layers will increase from 8 to 12 floors, and we’re introducing a brand-new brace technology - a key tech to strengthen tower stability and expand your structures horizontally, for more creative freedom to build your unique sky-high architecture.



We've also made improvements to citizen needs, upgraded tower-building animations, and added clearer tutorials—all designed to make your skyword journey more engaging and rewarding!



Try out the demo on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/_Demo/
Save Files Compatibility & Legacy Branch Access
Since the new patch brings significant changes to core gameplay mechanics (we have reworked the whole buff system by the way), please note that the existing save files will not be compatible with the new version.



As a simulation game that heavily involves resource management, updates to the balancing system—especially the rework of various stats—are a key part of refining the player experience and enhancing the flow of tower construction.



We strongly recommend starting fresh with the new version to enjoy all improvements. However, for players who wish to continue their previous save files, we’ll open a temporary legacy branch after the new update. This will allow you to switch back and continue building your tower up to floor 12 in the older version:

 Right-click on the game in your Steam library

 Select Properties

 Click the BETAS tab

 In the list under "Select the beta you would like to opt-in to", select “v0.1.7_legacy”

 Close the properties menu

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/27a01cae6d15c521f7201d49417ff7e55f8e31e6.png"]

Please note that the legacy branch is only available during the demo period. After Steam Next Fest, we’ll be gathering feedback and continuing to make major adjustments, thus we can’t guarantee demo save files will carry over to the full release. Babel wasn’t built in a day, right?  



Through early feedback and shared effort with our community, we hope to deconstruct, rebuild, and ultimately deliver a more stable and complete tower-building experience at launch.


June 6 Update LogFeatures:
 Tower construction limit raised to 12 layers.

 Housing Upgrade System: When Spirit conditions are met, Huts can automatically upgrade into Brick Houses, increasing living space and work range.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/e83e7daa01202d2a23a569c06f95681bcf27ae2d.png"]

 Brace Technology unlocked: Use braces beneath buildings to reinforce them, significantly expanding horizontal construction potential.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/2a4568b488adb0570d187a2ae61769ad3a94dd21.png"]

 New Structures – Small & Large Frames: Lighter than structural blocks, ideal for horizontal expansion or creative stacking.

 Disasters can blow away Towertizens with low Disaster Shelter (let’s hope they land safely!).

 Rare resources may be brought in by disasters – make good use of them!

 Industrial Core and Ecological Garden now support selecting multiple production items for bonus output.

 Some buildings now require ongoing item consumption to maintain their bonus effects (e.g., Greenhouse consumes Water).

 Added tutorial guidance for Build Menu, Demolition Tool, Brace Tool, Housing Upgrade, Stability Mode, and Single-layer Display Mode.


Changes:
 Small Balloon Station can now transport two types of items.

 During disasters, no new Towertizens will arrive, and certain items will be consumed faster.

 Visual effects for Mist disasters have been improved.

 Plantations and Farms now occupy 3 height units.

 Adjusted Towertizen model scale – now about 3 meters tall (down from 5 meters).

 Research speed has been adjusted.

 Added more animations for Towertizens working in buildings.

 Added several sound effects.


Bugfixes:
 Fixed an issue where new Pipes connected to under-construction ones could become suspended in midair.

 Fixed a bug where stored resources in the tower body would not display correctly when exceeding 1000 units.


UI：
 Added Traditional Chinese localization.

 Save menu now shows save version info and warns of incompatible versions.

 Updated tooltip: replaced "Overhanging Weight" with the clearer term "Stability".

 Selecting a residence now highlights its work range across tower layers.

 Renamed "Shrub Garden" to "Plantation".

 Added a custom program icon for the game.

 Fixed several localization errors and text overflow issues.



If you encounter any issues during the demo, or you have any idea that you want to share with us, feel free to click the banner and join our Discord for support and feedback:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/240c45e6709e7fc5195ca878b8ad6b8cfa66defe.png"]

Bugfixes:

 Fixed a bug where removing ghosted buildings could cause tower layers to overlap with Jellyfish Bay.
 Fixed an issue introduced in v0.1.6.1653 where some buildings could no longer be selected (invalid buildings caused by the update will now be removed).
 Fixed a bug where background images in the opening scene were stretched abnormally at certain screen resolutions.
 Fixed a bug where Greenhouses and Signposts did not lose durability over time.
 Fixed a bug where custom keybindings were not reflected in button prompt text.
 Fixed a bug where Towertizens could be left floating after a building was removed.
 Fixed an issue where some save file entries did not display proper save details.
 Fixed several localization errors and text overflow issues.

notes.title: Demo Update Log v0.1.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been two weeks since the demo of Stario: Haven Tower went live, and we’ve been incredibly encouraged by all the positive feedback and thoughtful suggestions from players. Thank you so much for your support!


Here’s what’s included in this update:

Feature:

 Added a new "Minimum Number of Porters" setting and related tutorial. No more worrying about accidental shortage of Porters.
 Added Volume Control Settings.
 Added a new "Clear Items in Pipe" function to resolve blockage issues.


Change:

 Changed the explanation for buildings lacking workers: “Too far from Houses” -> “Not enough nearby Towertizens.”
 Changed the tutorials.
 Increased the number of starting Towertizens.
 Slowed down the text speed in the opening animation.


Bugfix:

 Fixed several localization errors and missing translations.


Due to changes in the tutorials, progress of the tutorial will be reset for saves from previous versions. However, this does not affect the continued playability of existing save files.
If you have any thoughts or questions about the current version, feel free to join our community or Discord to discuss them.

notes.title: Demo is Live!
notes.content:
Stario: Haven Tower is now launching its first online demo! come and try it!

In this vertical city built around the tower, you will lead the Towertizens to ascend layer by layer toward the sky.
Unique construction mechanics, logistical challenges of vertical transportation, and mysterious creatures and wonders await you.
Let’s hope the Towertizens aren’t afraid of heights!

Play Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387080/

Some Questions You Might Have:

What content is included in the demo? How long can I play?
This demo includes content up to the 8th tower floor and most technologies from the first two climate zones.
You can expect 30 minutes to an hour of gameplay.

Can I carry over my demo save to the full version?
(Most likely) No. Since this is not the final version, significant adjustments and improvements may be made (which is exactly why we're releasing the demo for feedback).
Once the full version is released, we will do our best to support save data continuity in future updates.

I have a suggestion! I found a bug!
If you have any ideas or encounter any issues, feel free to join our community or Discord to discuss them.
Follow our social media for updates.

We can't wait to hear from you!

notes.title: Devlog #1 Wonders above Sky
notes.content:
Hello, my future friends. I’m the developer from Stargate Games, and the director of STARIO: Haven Tower.

This is my first Devlog, so I want to introduce the very beginning of the “tower game”.

Why a “tower”? Does it relate to a specific tower? Well, the idea comes from an Architecture class when I was in university. So, it’s not about any famous tower in the physical world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/5e7e3c24aa4d06e5d27db2071ae3348faf7575a9.png
(Pictures of our classwork.)

We had a topic on “A thousand-meter-tall settlement”. The dimension of it is 600M (L) * 600M (W) * 1000M (H). And we are asked to discuss the issues of this vertical tower-city – the opposition of city and countryside on this city; the development of the city…
This topic has been on my mind till today. I was not merely intrigued by the macro perspective on this project, my thoughts are mostly about some underlying issues:

- What’s living on a high vertical tower be like?
- Would people have vertigo living on higher levels?
- How long would people wait for the elevators?
- Would there be sky-viewing houses over a sea of clouds?
- Would people have anoxia due to thin air?

One day, I found some ideas on these questions in a game.
I was playing The Twilight Forest Mod in Minecraft and there is a sky-high tree in the game. It’s a hollow tree, with about 3m2 space inside. There are vines growing inside, allowing me to climb up and down.
So, I make my home inside the tree.

Because of the limited horizontal space, I’ll have to build my stuff vertically.
From the living room at the highest position, I put stove, workbench, growing area, farms, storage, enchanting area, spoils of wars and showcases each level below.
I dug holes every couple level, to build a viewing platform hanging outside the big tree.

The scale of this tower city is not as big as I imagined, but it’s relatively big in this game. It was a refreshing experience, making my fantasy fulfilled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/e222bfd8385d90c29be1eb33dcb17811a6498699.jpg
(A tree house I made in Minecraft)

Today, I’m still attracted by all kinds of towers in this world ---
The megastructures in other fantasy stories,
The lighthouse the protagonist was training in from the film TENET,
The endlessly expanding and all-inclusive skyscraper from the Library of Babel,
and the giant tower from the Tower of Babylon by Ted Chiang, and I shall quote a few lines from it:

 After dinner, he asked Kudda and his family, “Have any of you ever visited Babylon?”
Kudda’s wife, Alitum, answered, “No, why would we? It’s a long climb, and we have all we need here.”
“You have no desire to actually walk on the earth?”
Kudda shrugged. “We live on the road to heaven; all the work that we do is to extend it further. When we leave the tower, we will take the upward ramp, not the downward.” 

And I have a lot of pictures collected, of towers, of skyscrapers, of giant vertical structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206500/798e451e443e370ca15ff2ebb5c90053ece63447.png
(Here is some of my collections for reference.)

So, I started thinking about doing something on this idea.
For the spectacularity, the curiosity of life, and the answer for that topic 10 years ago.
For the imagination and great expectations mankind having for the skies, I started this project. 

That’s how everything comes together.

In the next Devlog, I’ll talk about the design, gameplay and logics of this game.
Until next time.
